webp.notes: sharpyuv/ was split out of src/enc in 1.3.x and is now a hard dependency of the encoder - already handled here, but flag any *new* top-level dirs a future release adds.

zlib.notes: Flat layout - merge-copy so ZLib.2017.vcxproj* (FreeImage's own, not upstream) survive. zlib >= 1.3 needs -DHAVE_UNISTD_H on non-Windows (see CMakeLists.txt comment) - re-check this is still needed/correct after bumping.

libpng.notes: Flat layout - merge-copy so LibPNG.2017.vcxproj* survive. pnglibconf.h is a generated/checked-in config header, not part of the upstream tarball - diff it against pnglibconf.h.prebuilt after bumping in case new PNG_*_SUPPORTED toggles were added.

libtiff.notes: Flat layout - merge-copy so LibTIFF4.2017.vcxproj* survive. Official repo moved to GitLab; tif_config.h/tiffconf.h are checked-in generated headers, not part of upstream - review after bumping.

libjpeg.notes: This is IJG's original libjpeg (jversion.h says e.g. '9d'), NOT libjpeg-turbo - pass --version as IJG's own scheme (e.g. '9f', '10'), not a semver. Flat layout - merge-copy so LibJPEG.2017.vcxproj* and jconfig.h (checked-in, not upstream) survive.

libopenjpeg.notes: Flat layout - merge-copy so LibOpenJPEG.2017.vcxproj* and opj_config*.h (checked-in generated headers, not upstream) survive. Bundled is 2.0.0; upstream has restructured some internal APIs since - check PluginJ2K.cpp/PluginJP2.cpp/J2KHelper.cpp compile cleanly, this is a large multi-version jump.

libraw.notes: No 'v' prefix on LibRaw's git tags (e.g. '0.22.1', not 'v0.22.1').

openexr.notes: DO NOT use this script for OpenEXR - bundled is 2.2.0 (2017), and OpenEXR 3.x restructured the whole tree (Imath split into its own separate repo/library, IlmImf/IlmThread reorganized into OpenEXRCore, CMake-only build). This needs a manual, from-scratch integration, not a subdir replace. Flagged as high priority: the 3.4.14 release notes cite 15 CVE fixes over 2.2.0.

jxrlib.notes: Microsoft's original jxrlib is dead/unmaintained (last real upstream activity ~2017); there is no canonical current release to bump to. Only community forks exist (e.g. github.com/cgohlke/jxrlib). Low priority - JPEG XR is a rarely-used format and switching source entirely would need its own evaluation, not a version bump.
